body:
Indeed I can reproduce when prefixing with `%test`, i.e. `%test.quarkus.http.test-port=0`
In my project I was using `quarkus.http.test-port=0` which still works fine.
FWIW: `quarkus.http.test-port` set via `systemPropertyVariables` in surefire-plugin also still works.

Thanks for the workaround(s). It would be nice if someone explained what is happening and why it is behaving differently in 1.6.0.Final. If it is a desired behavior (and not a bug), it could possibly be added to the [migration guide](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/wiki/Migration-Guide-1.6)?
It's definitely a bug, I'll need to check it out
#10488 fixes the problem for the tests

body:
@geoand & @radcortez 

I just realized that this is also broken for devmode via system property. Does that make sense?

`application.yaml`:
```yaml
"%dev":
  quarkus:
    http:
      port: 2081
```
calling devmode:
```mvn quarkus:dev -Dquarkus.http.port=0```

will use 2081 instead of a random port.
When I remove the entry from yaml then it works.

I'll create a separate issue.
